title: Container Ships Got So Big They Changed World Trade
hook: One ship now carries 24,000 truckloads of cargo.
closing: Somewhere out there, one boat is holding your order -- and 11,000 other people's.
question: Ever tracked a package by ship?

segments.say: By 2019, the biggest container ship could carry 24,000 boxes -- one ship doing a small fleet's job.
The whole global container fleet has grown to 25.8 million boxes of capacity, up massively since 1990.
About 80 percent of everything traded in the world, by volume, moves by ship.
